<translated_code>
#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <algorithm>
#include <string>
#include <cmath>
#include <random>
#include <bitset>
#include <cassert>

using namespace std;

const int MAXN = 61;

long long ways[MAXN][MAXN];

struct Half {
	long long match;
	long long value;

	Half(long long match, long long value) : match(match), value(value) {}

	bool operator < (const Half &other) const {
		return value < other.value;
	}
};

long long getWins(char *s, int r, int c) {
	int curA = 0;
	int curB = 0;
	long long ret = 0;
	for (int i = 0; s[i]; i++) {
		if (s[i] == 'A') {
			curA++;
		} else {
			ret += choose(curB, r - 1) * choose(curA, r);
			curB++;
		}
	}
	return ret;
}

long long slow(int r, int c, string s) {
	int as[2 * (r + c)];
	for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
		as[i] = i;
	}
	long long totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][c];

	char buf[2 * (r + c)];
	memset(buf, 'B', sizeof(buf));

	long long bestDiff = INT_MAX;
	long long ans = 0;
	vector<string> good;

	do {
		memset(buf, 'B', sizeof(buf));
		for (int pos : as) {
			buf[pos] = 'A';
		}
		int match = 1;
		for (int i = 0; s[i]; i++) {
			if (s[i] != '?' && s[i] != buf[i]) {
				match = 0;
				break;
			}
		}
		long long winsA = getWins(buf, r, c);
		long long diff = abs(2 * winsA - totalWays);
		if (diff < bestDiff) {
			bestDiff = diff;
			good.clear();
			if (match == 1)
				good.push_back(string(buf, 2 * (r + c)));
			ans = match;
		} else if (diff == bestDiff) {
			ans += match;
			if (match == 1)
				good.push_back(string(buf, 2 * (r + c)));
		}
	} while (nextCombination(as, 2 * (r + c)));
	return ans;
}

long long solve(int r, int c, string s) {
	long long bestDiff = INT_MAX;
	long long ans = 0;

	long long maskA = 0;
	long long maskB = 0;
	int cnt[2 * (r + c) + 1][2];
	for (int i = 0; i < 2 * (r + c); i++) {
		cnt[i + 1] = cnt[i];
		if (s[i] == 'A') {
			cnt[i + 1][0]++;
			maskA |= 1LL << i;
		}
		if (s[i] == 'B') {
			cnt[i + 1][1]++;
			maskB |= 1LL << i;
		}
	}

	long long lastA = maskA >> (2 * r + c - 1);
	long long lastB = maskB >> (2 * r + c - 1);

	vector<Half> fst[c + 2];
	vector<Half> snd[c + 2];
	int sz[c + 2];
	for (int i = 0; i < c + 2; i++) {
		sz[i] = ways[c + 1][i];
		fst[i].resize(sz[i]);
		snd[i].resize(sz[i]);
	}

	for (int mask = 0; mask < (1 << (c + 1)); mask++) {
		int btc = __builtin_popcount(mask);
		int compBtc = c + 1 - btc;
		int idx = sz[btc] - 1;
		{
			int samePref = min(__builtin_ctz((mask & 1) == 0 ? mask : (mask + 1)), c + 1);

			int totalA = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][0];
			int totalB = r - 1 - cnt[2 * r - 2 + samePref][1];
			if ((mask & 1) == 0) {
				totalA += samePref;
			} else {
				totalB += samePref;
			}

			long long winsA = 0;

			int curA = 0;
			int curB = 0;
			for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
				if (test(mask, i)) {
					winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
					curB++;
				} else {
					curA++;
				}
			}

			int exactMatch = 1;
			for (int i = samePref; i < c + 1; i++) {
				if (!test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'B') {
					exactMatch = 0;
					break;
				}
				if (test(mask, i) && s[2 * r - 2 + i] == 'A') {
					exactMatch = 0;
					break;
				}
			}

			fst[btc][idx] = Half(choose(totalA + totalB, totalA) * exactMatch, winsA);
		}

		{
			int match = 1;
			if (((~mask) & lastB) != 0) {
				match = 0;
			}
			if ((mask & lastA) != 0) {
				match = 0;
			}

			long long winsA = 0;

			int curA = btc;
			int curB = compBtc;
			for (int i = 0; i < c + 1; i++) {
				if (test(mask, i)) {
					winsA += ways[r - 1 + curB][r - 1] * choose(r - 1 + curA, r);
					curB++;
				} else {
					curA++;
				}
			}

			snd[btc][idx] = Half(match, winsA);
		}
	}

	long long totalWays = ways[r + c][r] * ways[r + c][r];
	long long halfTotal = totalWays / 2;

	for (int i = 0; i <= c + 1; i++) {
		sort(fst[i].begin(), fst[i].end());
		sort(snd[c + 1 - i].begin(), snd[c + 1 - i].end());

		int ptr = snd[c + 1 - i].size() - 1;

		for (Half a : fst[i]) {
			while (ptr >= 0 && a.value + snd[c + 1 - i][ptr].value > halfTotal) {
				ptr--;
			}
			if (ptr >= 0) {
				update(a, snd[c + 1 - i][ptr]);
			}
			if (ptr + 1 < snd[c + 1 - i].size()) {
				update(a, snd[c + 1 - i][ptr + 1]);
			}
		}
	}
	return ans;
}

void update(Half a, Half b) {
	long long totalValue = a.value + b.value;
	long long diff = abs(2 * totalValue - totalWays);
	long long delta = a.match * b.match;
	if (diff < bestDiff) {
		bestDiff = diff;
		ans = delta;
	} else if (diff == bestDiff) {
		ans += delta;
	}
}

vector<Half> compress(vector<Half> arr) {
	sort(arr.begin(), arr.end());
	int sz = 1;
	for (int i = 1; i < arr.size(); i++) {
		if (arr[i].value == arr[sz - 1].value) {
			arr[sz - 1].match += arr[i].match;
		} else {
			arr[sz++] = arr[i];
		}
	}
	return vector<Half>(arr.begin(), arr.begin() + sz);
}

long long choose(int n, int k) {
	return n >= 0 && k >= 0 && k <= n ? ways[n][k] : 0;
}

bool test(int mask, int i) {
	return ((mask >> i) & 1) == 1;
}

void preCalc() {
	for (int i = 0; i < MAXN; i++) {
		ways[i] = new long[i + 1];
		ways[i][0] = ways[i][i] = 1;
		for (int j = 1; j < i; j++) {
			ways[i][j] = ways[i - 1][j - 1] + ways[i - 1][j];
		}
	}
}

int nextCombination(int *a, int n) {
	int k = n;
	int ptr = k - 1;
	while (ptr >= 0 && a[ptr] == ptr - k + n) {
		ptr--;
	}
	if (ptr < 0) {
		return -1;
	}
	a[ptr]++;
	for (int i = ptr + 1; i < k; i++) {
		a[i] = a[ptr] + i - ptr;
	}
	return 0;
}

int main() {
	preCalc();
	int r, c;
	cin >> r >> c;
	string s;
	cin >> s;
	cout << solve(r, c, s) << endl;
	return 0;
}
